title: Instructional Designer – XR Content Development
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Key Responsibilities XR Storyboarding & Learning Design Analyze technical documentation, training materials, procedures, and engineering inputs. Visualize XR training concepts and transform them into clear, engaging, and interactive storyboards. Create detailed storyboards that guide XR, AR, VR, and 3D content development. Design learner-centric training experiences that improve knowledge retention and performance. Ensure instructional content follows established learning methodologies and XR best practices. Partner with SMEs, Instructors, Engineering teams, and Training Managers to gather requirements and validate content. Work closely with Mixed Reality Developers (MRDs) to translate storyboards into immersive XR experiences. Facilitate storyboard reviews, incorporate feedback, and drive approvals and sign-offs. Coordinate activities across global teams to ensure alignment and timely delivery of projects. Manage multiple XR projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and delivery timelines. Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Track project milestones, reviews, and stakeholder actions. Support continuous improvement initiatives, process standardization, and innovation within the XR team. Communicate project status, risks, and expectations effectively across different organizational levels. Build strong working relationships with cross-functional and multicultural teams. Demonstrates a positive attitude, willingness to learn new technologies, and openness to challenges. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Engineering, Technical Communication, Education, Learning Technologies, or a related field. 6–10 years of experience in Instructional Design, Learning Experience Design, Technical Training Development, or XR Content Development. Proven experience developing storyboards for technical, 3D, AR, VR, or XR learning solutions. Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies. Experience working with technical documentation, procedures, and engineering content. Minimum Qualifications Key Skills & Competencies XR, AR, VR, or 3D learning content visualization experience. Storyboard development and learning content design expertise. Experience using Microsoft Office tools (Power Point, Word, Excel, Teams). Added advantage using tools like Adobe Captivate, Articulate Storyline
360. Familiarity with 3D/XR workflows and collaboration with design or development teams. Understanding of multimedia learning principles. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-driven, proactive, and highly organized. Ability to manage ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities. Attention to detail and quality-focused mindset. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in manufacturing, semiconductor, engineering, or technical training environments. Experience supporting AR/VR/XR training content development. Knowledge of learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning technologies. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. jobDescription: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Group/Division Enabling the movement toward advanced chip design, KLA's Measurement, Analytics and Control group (MACH) is looking for the best and brightest research scientists, software engineers, application development engineers and senior product technology process engineers to join our team. title: Technical Lead, Software Development

You will have the opportunity to occasionally travel to customers and discover new places and cultures along the way. Team training sessions and access to online learning portals will ensure that your knowledge stays up-to-date and allow you to grow beyond your current know-how. From on the edge software development, designing advanced machines, defining and implementing image processing algorithms or crafting new ways to do optical inspections, we do it all, and we need your talent to keep going one step beyond! title: Engineer, Software Test Automation
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Must have Master's Level Degree in CS or related fields Must have excellent communication, analytical and interpersonal skill. Must also be self-driven, yet a strong team player Background in IC processing/Semiconductor equipment is a plus. Hands-on experience with automation tools is a plus Must be desiring to travel and enjoy working in other cultures. Software Quality Engineer

RESPONSIBILITIES:
The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to plan, manage, execute, and report results for all qualification activities for the team. He/She will be an effective team player and leader that will be responsible for the quality of all released products. He/She will be a strong process advocate with an acute attention to detail and desire to continually improve the Qualification process. He/She must be able to partner with other functional teams to resolve quality issues quickly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to architect, implement, and scale test automation solutions that drive quality across KLA products. They will be a technically strong individual contributor and leader, responsible for building AI-augmented automation frameworks that ensure the reliability of all released products. They will champion modern testing practices with a sharp focus on automation coverage, infrastructure excellence, and continuous improvement of the qualification process. They must be able to partner with cross-functional teams globally to resolve quality issues quickly. Key Responsibilities Include: Identify, evaluate, and implement test automation frameworks and tools that deliver measurable value across the qualification lifecycle — including functional, regression, performance, and reliability testing. Own and drive automated test coverage for both UI and API layers across KLA products, designing robust test suites and publishing results, recommendations, and best known methods. Integrate AI capabilities into the test automation framework — including self-healing locators, intelligent test generation, and autonomous test execution — to improve test resilience and reduce maintenance overhead. Leverage deep knowledge of software systems and application architecture to design scalable infrastructure solutions that empower the test automation team. Assess automation feasibility of test cases and script them for automatic execution across new and existing product features. Technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, and Customer Support teams across global locations for various requirements. Participate in all stages of software development including deployment and troubleshooting at customer sites. Represent the SQE team in product lifecycle and key program meetings. Travel to customer fabrication facilities to understand customer use cases, deploy software, and troubleshoot. KLA Corporation, a leading provider of process control and yield management solutions, partners with customers around the world to develop state-of-the-art inspection and metrology technologies. These technologies serve the semiconductor, data storage, LED, and other related nanoelectronics industries. With a portfolio of industry-standard products and a team of world-class engineers and scientists, the company has created superior solutions for its customers for 50 years. Headquartered in Milpitas, California., KLA has dedicated customer operations and service centers around the world. Additional information may be found at www.kla.com Software Quality Engineering (SQE) is a functional organization in KLA’s Central engineering group which serves all wafer inspection products in qualifying the products and qualifying to release the differentiated products to help our customers. SQE is seeking Product qualification engineers in our Chennai, India campus to enhance our Quality team. Minimum Qualifications Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field Strong communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills; self-driven with the ability to work effectively as part of a team Background in IC processing or semiconductor equipment is a plus Hands-on experience with automation tools is a plus Willingness to travel and ability to work in diverse cultural environments We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. title: Manager, Software Architecture and Platform Modernization
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strong software architecture background with experience designing complex, distributed, high-performance, or data-intensive software systems. Proven ability to work with both legacy platforms and modern technology stacks. Experience in one or more of the following areas: Enterprise software architecture Cloud-native services Microservices or service-oriented architecture AI/ML infrastructure Big data processing Dev Ops and engineering automation High-performance computing or large-scale data pipelines Ability to lead through influence across functions, geographies, and organizational boundaries. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to simplify ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs, and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions. Experience mentoring senior engineers, architects, or technical leads. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain architecture choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bias for ownership, execution, and long-term technical excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering Technical Skills: Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separation Working knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation. Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and Dev Ops principles. Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. - Java, Python, C#, C++, · Strong knowledge of Design & Architectural patterns · Good knowledge on Open source software and varied technologies (web and thick client). title: Manager, Software Engineering
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Platform Architecture: Oversee the design and implementation of scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems optimized for hybrid CPU/GPU workloads. Lifecycle Management: Lead the end-to-end development of image computing platforms, from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance, using best-in-class project management practices. title: Software Engineer
jobDescription: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division KLA advanced computing Labs’ (ACL) mission in India is to deliver advanced parallel computing research and software architectures for AI + HPC + Cloud solutions to accelerate the performance of KLA's products. ACL explores high-risk approaches, pioneering technologies, and novel methods to accelerate KLA’s algorithms and contribute to KLA’s HPC technology roadmap. Located out of the IIT Madras Research Park in Chennai, India, we engage leading thinkers in academia, industry and KLA’s business units to create innovative parallel computing methods to enable KLA’s business growth. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Software Engineer to join our dynamic team focused on scientific computing and modelling solutions. This role is ideal for engineers with a strong background in C# or C++, and experience developing on the .NET/Windows platform. You will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of software used for modelling and computational workflows that support CD and thin film measurement systems. You will work closely with scientists and engineers to translate complex computational requirements into robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions. 🔹 Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain software applications using C# or C++ on the .NET/Windows platform. Collaborate with scientists and engineers to translate modelling and computational requirements into robust software solutions. Design and development of scalable, performant, and maintainable software solutions for computationally intensive applications. Optimize code for performance, scalability, and efficiency in scientific computing environments. Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and validation to ensure high-quality deliverables. Contribute to UI/UX design and implementation where applicable. Document software designs, workflows, and usage for internal and external stakeholders. 🔹 Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 8+ years of professional experience in software development. Proficiency in C# or C++, with strong knowledge of the .NET framework and Windows development. Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems. Experience in scientific computing, modelling, or computationally intensive applications. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Experience translating complex requirements into technical architecture and execution plans. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to handle complex technical challenges. Excellent communication and collaboration skills in global team environments. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf). 🔹 Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have) Experience in building complex distributed systems. title: XR & Multimedia Production Manager
jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Managerial Roles & Responsibilities Team Leadership & Mentorship: Direct and mentor a staff of technical production specialists, fostering a culture of collaboration and professional excellence. Strategic Project Management: Own the end-to-end execution of XR programs from conception to launch, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives and product goals. Resource & Budget Oversight: Manage multimedia budgets, allocate hardware/software resources effectively, and handle contracts with external vendors and contractors. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison between the media team and stakeholders in marketing, engineering, and executive leadership to align content with broader campaigns. Workflow Optimization: Identify and implement process improvements to increase production efficiency, such as documenting new production tools or managing digital asset libraries. Quality & Brand Assurance: Ensure all multimedia and XR content maintains brand voice, adheres to accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG/ADA), and meets strict quality benchmarks before release. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Software Engineer – LS‑SWIFT Division KLA Corporation Company Overview Are you ready to work at the edge of what’s possible—where breakthroughs are measured in nanometers and impact is felt worldwide? At KLA, we push the limits of nanotechnology—fueling the digital revolution that shapes how the world lives, works, and connects. We research, develop, and manufacture the world’s most advanced inspection and measurement equipment for the semiconductor and nanoelectronics industries. Our tools are capable of detecting defects smaller than the wavelength of visible light, enabling technology leaders to manufacture faster, smarter, and more reliably. From the smartphone in your pocket to the electronics driving AI, mobility, healthcare, and beyond, KLA technologies are foundational to modern innovation. We are passionate about solving complex problems, advancing technology, and enabling what would otherwise be impossible. The future is calling. Will you answer? Group / Division With over 40 years of leadership in semiconductor process control, KLA is trusted by chipmakers around the globe to ramp next‑generation devices into high‑volume production—quickly and cost‑effectively. The Global Products Group (GPG) is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products. GPG brings together world‑class research scientists, software engineers, application developers, and product technologists focused on solving the industry’s most demanding challenges. LS‑SWIFT Division The LS‑SWIFT Division, part of GPG, delivers patterned wafer inspection systems for high‑volume semiconductor manufacturing. Our mission is to provide market‑leading cost of ownership in defect detection across a broad range of semiconductor applications. Customers across foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, and advanced packaging markets rely on LS‑SWIFT products for high‑sampling, high‑value wafer inspection insights. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost‑effective patterned wafer defect detection for leading‑edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver full wafer‑surface macro inspection—frontside, backside, and edge—critical for automotive ICs, MEMS, advanced packaging, and memory manufacturing. LS‑SWIFT operates globally across the United States, Singapore, India, and Germany, serving customers throughout Asia, Europe, and North America. Join a thriving, high‑performing team where creativity is encouraged, collaboration is valued, and a caring, inclusive culture empowers engineers to do their best work and grow their careers. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain high‑performance, production‑grade software using C# and/or Java Succeed in a high‑velocity engineering environment, using ninja‑level programming skills and sound judgment to move quickly without compromising quality Build world‑class user experience products by developing adaptive, scalable frontend and backend systems tailored for high‑volume jobDescription:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

ROLE:
Lead Software Engineer position to work on SFS division's SPx products based on Common software platform. Essential

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of Surfscan software. Be the technology evangelist for Surfscan product division Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future-proof and scalable. Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software. Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements. Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC & Wafer customers) Follow KT defined software development processes Lead small teams to develop key features on need basis. In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization’s development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solutions. Stay up to date with new technologies and methodologies that can enhance architecture, user experience, or development processes. Drive the architecture and technical design of various components within the platform.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 6+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products (Or) Master's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 4+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products Requirements: Strong in programming fundamentals, C#, C++, COM. Experience in Architecting systems from scratch, leading project teams. Diverse Experience in analysis, design, development, and unit testing Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering Experience in developing enterprise applications in .NET/C# using object-oriented concepts. Proficiency in object-oriented development principles, and relational database design patterns. Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction. Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking. Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments. Preferred Experience: Experience in developing COM/DCOM using MFC/ATL Experience in .Net and C#. Knowledge in STL, Boost Library, Win DBG and Windows Internals. Knowledge of CMM or other process models Knowledge of KT specific or general semiconductor domain Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. description:
Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

ROLE:
Lead Software Engineer position to work on SFS division's SPx products based on Common software platform. Essential

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of Surfscan software. Be the technology evangelist for Surfscan product division Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future-proof and scalable. Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software. Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements. Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC & Wafer customers) Follow KT defined software development processes Lead small teams to develop key features on need basis. In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization’s development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solution. Requirements: Strong in programming fundamentals, C++, VC++, MFC and COM. Experience in Architecting systems from scratch, leading project teams. Diverse Experience in analysis, design, development and unit testing Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction. Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking. Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments. Preferred Experience: Experience in developing COM/DCOM using MFC/ATL Experience in .Net and C#. Knowledge in STL, Boost Library, Win DBG and Windows Internals. Knowledge of CMM or other process models Knowledge of KT specific or general semiconductor domain Minimum Qualifications

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications As the HPC Software Manager, you will build & lead a team responsible for architecting and developing the distributed software infrastructure that powers image computing clusters across the LS division. This role is pivotal in enabling scalable, high-performance platforms that support advanced image processing and AI workloads. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Strategic Leadership: Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for distributed HPC software infrastructure supporting image computing clusters. Team Development: Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers and technical leaders. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with product, hardware, and algorithm teams to align infrastructure capabilities with evolving image processing and AI requirements. Platform Architecture: Oversee the design and implementation of scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems optimized for hybrid CPU/GPU workloads. Lifecycle Management: Lead the end-to-end development of image computing platforms, from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance, using best-in-class project management practices. Developer Enablement: Deliver robust software platforms and tools that empower engineers to develop, test, and deploy new image processing and deep learning algorithms efficiently. Innovation in Hybrid Computing: Spearhead the integration of traditional image processing and AI/DL techniques into a unified hybrid computing architecture, leveraging modern HPC technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4 years in technical leadership or management roles. Proven track record in building and scaling distributed systems, preferably in HPC or cloud-native environments. Experience with image processing, computer vision, or AI/ML infrastructure is highly desirable. Technical Skills: Deep Understanding of distributed computing frameworks & Linux Systems Programming Proficiency in C++, Python, and/or other systems programming languages. Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
